character_facts: Steelhead prioritizes preserving the Metabaron line but also acts to save the female child.
Steelhead performs radical medical and bodily interventions on family members and on himself.
Dona Vicenta suffers from tuberculosis and later a pulmonary hemorrhage.
Aghora is born from the saved twin arrangement and raised as the effective male heir.
Aghora tames a Tarantuwolf named Deyanira at a very young age.
Aghora loses her left hand and receives a bionic replacement during her rite of passage.
Aghora works as an executioner before seeking answers from the Golden Planet.
Steelhead replaces his flesh with Storlon after being overcome by grief.
characters_present: the male twin/brother whose brain is transplanted

lore_facts: Metabaron succession is described as traditionally passing from father to son.
Advanced surgery in this setting can transplant a brain from one twin into the other's body.
A body can be held in stasis, including long-term preservation in a chamber or cocoon.
Near-death preservation appears medically possible in this universe.
Metabaron initiation includes severe bodily modification.
Bionic prosthetics are used as part of Metabaron transformation.
Storlon is identified as an indestructible metal.
Khaliyuga is a prison planet populated by deadly alien criminals.
The Empire has an Imperial Court that assigns missions.
Mirror Ships are associated with an alien race that invades the universe and destroys the Imperial Fleet.
plot_events: Dona Vicenta, close to death from tuberculosis, is told only one of her twins can be born.
Steelhead chooses to save the female child despite the Metabaron lineage traditionally passing from father to son.
Steelhead preserves both twins by transplanting the boy's brain into the girl's body and placing the boy's body in stasis.
After Dona Vicenta sees her daughter Aghora, she suffers a pulmonary hemorrhage and Steelhead keeps her in a near-death preserved state.
Steelhead finds a Tarantuwolf to nurse Aghora, and by age five Aghora has tamed it and named it Deyanira.
During Aghora's first Metabaron rite of passage, her left hand is replaced with a bionic hand and her body is altered so she can live as a male heir.
Aghora serves as executioner on the prison planet Khaliyuga, killing dangerous alien criminals.
Grieving for Dona Vicenta, Steelhead replaces his flesh with the metal Storlon.
Aghora cannot kill Steelhead in combat for the Metabaron title, so she destroys Dona Vicenta's body and seals Steelhead in a stasis cocoon, sending him into deep space.
Aghora waits three years for an Imperial Court assignment, but none comes.
When Mirror Ships of an alien race devastate the Imperial Fleet, the Empire still does not summon Aghora.
Aghora heads to the Golden Planet to learn why no one has called for the Metabaron's aid.
